basic_info.description: Welcome to Madrone 1504, an exceedingly rare high floor home with views of the Bay Bridge, city and bay. The split floorplan maximizes the views from the living room leading to the private balcony. An open chef's kitchen with space for dining creates an ideal space for entertaining. The primary suite features an en-suite bathroom with great closet space. The second bedroom is ideal for family members, guests or an office. Air conditioning and heat, in-unit laundry, one car parking, and storage complete this incredible offering. Madrone exemplifies luxurious Mission Bay living. Amenities include 24-hour door persons, on-site management, a state-of-the art fitness center, outdoor pool and jacuzzi, owner's lounge, and a business center. With its incredible location and spectacular views, Madrone 1504 should not be missed.
